verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side ingestion, with a batch endpoint for sending multiple events in one request, so the core server-to-server ingestion path exists. However, the evidence never covers authentication for the events collector; the bearer-token auth shown applies to the separate management REST API, so it does not transfer here. Nothing in the pack addresses delivery guarantees such as retries, acknowledgements or deduplication. Missing for 10: documented authentication for the event ingestion API, delivery guarantees (retry/ack/idempotency semantics), independent or hands-on corroboration.
